steps: At the already-proven Start dispatcher boundary PC=$C14F, compare physical page-$34 and mapped helper bytes $A8A0-$A8F6 with the retained staged/current helper and record PAR5 before advancing.

Trap and log the first active worklist boundary, then the earliest relevant active-tick/helper-cache call and return; compare live code at each stopped PC with its current built artifact before symbol interpretation.
Instrument whether the run JSON-RPC acknowledgement and requested breakpoint event arrive, preserving breakpoint ID and last observer event.

Bound the run wait to 40 seconds. If no marker arrives, use a pre-opened second monitor client in the remaining 5 seconds to pause and record PC, PAR0-PAR7, process/run state and live bytes at PC; do not infer target slowness from timeout.
